verdict.rationale: Automatic conferencing links on bookings is a fair question for a calendar product that offers appointment booking pages, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only lists "Appointment booking pages" and never mentions Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, or any video link being attached to bookings automatically. Booking pages alone are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, every booking gets a video conference link automatically (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or native video)
